description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of automated test cases for interacting with a Perforce (p4) version control system, including operations such as starting the server, adding jobs, submitting files, applying changelists, and cloning repositories. It also verifies log message contents to ensure proper tracking of jobs associated with changelists.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server for testing.

methods.name: p4_add_job
methods.description: Adds a new job in Perforce with the specified ID.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets the client view for depot mapping.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to Perforce with a description.

methods.name: p4 fix
methods.description: Associates a changelist with a job.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets cleanup actions after a test.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the Git environment after tests.
